تتداخلي (form VI)
# تَتَدَاخَلِي (tatadāḵalī) /ta.ta.daː.xa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
# تُتَدَاخَلِي (tutadāḵalī) /tu.ta.daː.xa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَاخَلَ (tadāḵala)
